name: Dan Tel Aviv
positioning: Tel Aviv's first luxury hotel, on the Mediterranean Sea boardwalk at 99 HaYarkon Street, and a member of The Leading Hotels of the World
best_for: Travelers who want a seafront base on the promenade between the Old Tel Aviv Port and Jaffa
Guests who want both an outdoor sea-water pool and an indoor heated pool

facts.text: The hotel is located on Tel Aviv's Mediterranean Sea boardwalk.
The hotel overlooks the sea and the beaches.
The hotel is at 99 HaYarkon Street.
The Dan Tel Aviv was the first luxury hotel to be built in Tel Aviv.
The Dan Tel Aviv is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
The hotel's design is contemporary with a classic elegant twist.
The hotel has a fully equipped gym and a dry sauna.
Heading north on the promenade leads to the Old Tel Aviv Port.
Heading south on the promenade leads to the ancient port city of Jaffa.
The hotel is near the city's nightclubs and bars.
On Tuesday nights, Timeless Tuesday offers a special menu and live DJ music.

highlights.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool with sea water and an indoor heated swimming pool.
Guestrooms and suites face either the sea or the city.
The hotel is known for its colorful facade.
The hotel has hosted international VIPs including Paul McCartney, Madonna and The Rolling Stones.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed, though guide dogs and service dogs are.
The hotel's parking is operated by an external company.
WhataHotel notes some rooms may show signs of age.
